title: Sri Lanka Island Family
headline: Wildlife, hills and a last night on the coast.
description: Eight nights for a family: the cultural triangle, Kandy, tea country, Yala and Bentota.
image_alt: Nine Arches Bridge and a train in the hills near Ella, Sri Lanka
price_label: Quoted for your family and dates
price_guidance: This longer circuit depends on room type, child ages, safari jeep and whether the hill-country train is booked. We confirm a written total before you reserve.
overview: A fuller family island: fortress and Kandy first, tea country and Ella, a Yala morning, then two nights on Bentota to recover. Stays are short in the middle; the beach close is not.
highlights: Cultural-triangle stay with one fortress morning.
Kandy lake and the Temple of the Tooth.
Tea country, Ella and a Yala safari as quoted.
Two nights on a family beach before you fly.
why: Wildlife, hills and sea without covering the whole island.
Climbs and safari can be cut for younger children.
The same driver stays with you on the circuit.
inclusions: Accommodation on twin or family-room sharing as quoted
One shared or private Yala jeep when included in the quote
exclusions: Site tickets and extra safari drives unless added
Personal expenses, GST and tourism fees

stay.name: Selected family-friendly hotels on a six-stop circuit
stay.room: Twin, double or interconnecting rooms as available

notes: Safari, climb choice and beach town are confirmed in writing. Parks and some sites close on set days or in heavy rain. An inquiry is not a booking.
itinerary_note: Suggested family order through the triangle, hills, Yala and the west coast. A hill night can be dropped for more beach time.
